summary: Completed comprehensive frontend testing of KrishiVoice Chain agriculture marketplace. Tested homepage, role selection, and all four portal dashboards (Farmer, Buyer, Admin, Consumer). Found one critical UI bug with role selection functionality.

ui_bugs.issue: Role card selection not updating continue button text - always shows 'Continue as Farmer' regardless of selected role
ui_bugs.impact: Users cannot properly navigate to their intended role portal from homepage

ui_bugs.issue: Timeline verification results not appearing immediately after clicking demo button
ui_bugs.impact: Demo functionality may appear broken to users

passed_tests: Homepage loads with hero section and stats (10K+ Farmers, 98% Trust Score, 50K+ Transactions, 24/7 AI Support)
All four role selection cards are present and clickable
Farmer dashboard loads with stats, tabs navigation (Overview, Sell Crop, Voice, Inventory, Wallet), and quick actions
Buyer marketplace shows search functionality, filters (crop type, sort), and product listings (3 found)
Admin panel displays fraud alerts (3 active), trust leaderboard, and transaction monitoring
Consumer portal shows batch verification interface with QR scan functionality
Voice FAB button appears on all dashboard pages
Switch Role button navigates back to homepage from all portals
Direct navigation between all portals works correctly
Professional UI/UX with proper color theming per role (Green for Farmer, Yellow for Buyer, Red for Admin, Green for Consumer)
Responsive design with proper typography (Outfit for headings, Manrope for body text)
action_item_for_main_agent: Fix role selection functionality on homepage - the selectedRole state is not properly updating the continue button text when different role cards are clicked. The button should show 'Continue as [Selected Role]' but currently always shows 'Continue as Farmer'.
